params.val: the user's next move is guaranteed to land a critical hit; expires after that

corrected from "2" to "1": verified via Showdown source (moves.ts laserfocus condition) — the raw internal duration counter is 2, but Laser Focus's own use-turn never benefits (it isn't a damaging move) and the generic per-turn decrement clears the volatile at the end of the following turn, so the crit guarantee is functionally live for exactly 1 turn, the user's very next move. The old "2" contradicted this event's own "next move ... expires after that" wording and was inconsistent with Lock-On/Mind Reader, which have the identical raw-duration-2 counter and were already correctly stored as 1 turn.
